_note: Pre-registration of the H100/vLLM study (plan v6 without LoRA). Written before any H100 DEV or TEST run; its sha256 is recorded at the freeze and checked before TEST and analysis. Copied and adapted from EntityClass/experiments/configs/comparisons_v6.json: E8/E9 (LoRA) removed; k tuned independently per model size; all Mac (llama.cpp/GGUF) runs are pilot data and are not used. Paired resampling over sentences; 10,000 bootstrap resamples and 10,000 permutations for F1; 2,000 resamples for AUROC; 95% percentile CIs; Holm correction within each tested family. Nothing is fitted or tuned on TEST.
runtime: vLLM, Hugging Face weights in BF16 (Qwen) and native MXFP4 (gpt-oss), one H100, tensor parallel 1, temperature 0, seed 0, JSON-schema constrained output; Qwen thinking disabled; gpt-oss reasoning_effort low

dev.selection: DEV micro-F1 per model and dataset, ties to the smaller k or m; validator thresholds (E4, E6) by DEV micro-F1 over a fixed 18-point grid

removed: LoRA/PEFT training and all comparisons involving it
unit_of_analysis: predicted span after alignment; unaligned classifier outputs reported in a sensitivity analysis as incorrect

scorers.W2: EntityClass frontier-LLM proposed weights (optional; elicited without DEV/TEST correctness; included only if configs/w2_frontier_weights.json exists at freeze time)
scorers.W3: EntityClass DEV-calibrated linear weights (non-negative, sum 1, simplex grid 0.05, pooled DEV AUROC of the primary validity set)
scorers.B2: surface seen in TRAIN with the same type
scorers.B3: logistic regression over the five criteria, fitted on DEV
scorers.B4: gradient-boosted trees over the five criteria (depth 3, 200 trees, learning rate 0.05), fitted on DEV

RQ1_criterion_validity.statistic: AUROC of each criterion for correct vs incorrect predicted spans, pooled over the primary validity set; two-sided sentence-bootstrap test of AUROC = 0.5; Holm over the five criteria
also_reported: with and without BERT for Consistency
ECE and Brier after isotonic mapping fitted on DEV

RQ3_weighting.statistic: paired sentence-bootstrap AUROC difference; Holm (W2 only if available)
RQ3_weighting.ablation: all criteria and minus each criterion, weights renormalised, under W0

report: every scorer per model (within-model AUROC with CI) and per dataset
strata A (seen same type) / B (seen other type) / C (unseen), minimum 30 correct and 30 incorrect rows per cell

scorecard_statistics: difference in W0 AUROC vs correctness
difference in false acceptance and false rejection

report: entity content, novelty and requested-domain consistency of the original synthetic corpora
silver quality on the TRAIN control
exposure to TEST (limitation): TEST-only mention rate and recall by seen / exposed / unseen mentions
